c0044: Months of rent held as a security deposit. It is set in your commercial lease, so check the terms before you sign
c0050: Cushion for operating expenses that are not budgeted
c0090: A new business does not sell on day one what it sells six months later. The daily volume above is the year-1 AVERAGE: the ramp only spreads year 1's sales across the months (slower start, stronger finish) and keeps the annual total. At 100% there is no ramp
c0093: Months of rent BEFORE opening (build-out and permits)
c0094: You pay for the space from the day you sign. These months are a startup cost: they do NOT overlap the P&L, which starts on opening day
c0095: Contingency on the BUILD-OUT lines of the space block (%)
c0096: Cushion on the build-out and fit-out line. A lender will not finance a renovation without it
c0258: The monthly amount is on the "0. Assumptions" tab; here it is multiplied by twelve. Rent for the build-out months, which comes before opening, is on the Startup Costs tab and is NOT counted twice
c0262: Enter the monthly bills excl. sales tax. The workbook applies a single tax treatment to this whole line, the one in the column next to it; if one utility is taxed differently in your area, give it its own line
c0806: Your health department sets what must be displayed (for example a consumer advisory and allergen notice, or ingredient and allergen labels), and the federal and state labor law posters go in a common area. If you serve alcohol, your state liquor license and its posted notices apply: check with your state alcohol agency
c0831: Security camera signage and contract with the security company
c0832: Post notices where your state requires them; check the rules on audio recording and keep footage only as long as you need it
c0835: Set up your POS to collect and report sales tax by location
